FreshCart demo meeting transcripts (WebVTT, Microsoft Teams style)

A realistic two-meeting story for testing and demonstrating NirnAIn end to end. Each file starts with a NOTE comment naming the meeting, its title, date, attendees and purpose; each agenda section is also marked with a NOTE comment. NirnAIn skips NOTE comments and reads only the spoken words.

M1_2026-12-07_FreshCart_kickoff.vtt (about 59 minutes)
Project kickoff for the FreshCart grocery delivery app at Greenleaf Markets: introductions, goals, scope and requirements, out of scope and open questions, deliverables, development approach, team hours and skills, budget ($480,000, 10 percent contingency, fixed), dates (start January 4, 2027, launch October 1, 2027, fixed), milestones, the security review and other dependencies, how strict each limit is, risks and next steps.
Use: Create Project from upload, then AI Project Intake and Scope Review (steps 1 to 3).

M2_2027-03-01_FreshCart_change_review.vtt (about 32 minutes)
Change review after Plan v1: new stakeholder Olivia Grant (Director of Loyalty and CRM), FreshPoints loyalty added to the launch scope, budget raised from $480,000 to $520,000, launch date October 1, 2027 unchanged, tablet layout out of scope, Kevin O'Brien from 32 to 24 hours a week from March 15, contractor Lucas Moreau joins for real-time tracking ($160 an hour, 30 hours a week), and the UX designs and clickable prototype done.
Use: after Plan v1 is applied, upload on step 7 (Changes & Versions) to record the change, re-plan and compare.

Team for step 5 (hours per week; skills on a 1 to 5 scale; employees at $90 an hour)
Marcus Chen, Tech Lead, 40: React Native 5, API design 4, Payments integration 3
Sofia Ramirez, Senior Mobile Developer, 40: React Native 4, iOS 4, Android 3, Payments integration 2
Kevin O'Brien, Mobile Developer, 32: React Native 3, Android 4, Performance tuning 3
Aisha Patel, Backend Developer, 40: Node.js 4, API design 4, Databases 4, Payments integration 2
Hannah Lee, UX/UI Designer, 24: UX design 5, UI design 5, Accessibility 4
Tom Wallace, QA Lead, 40: QA testing 5, Test automation 4, Accessibility testing 3
Nobody has real-time maps: a contractor is allowed at about $160 an hour (M1); Lucas Moreau joins in M2 (Real-time maps 5, React Native 4).

Limits (step 5): budget must hold, launch date must hold, capacity can flex (up to one extra day a week), skills must hold, five working days a week.
